findings.text: follow-on: _NAME_LINK_RE is a near-verbatim copy of graph_ops._DOC_LINK_RE (imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:9545) and the markdown branch of graph_ops._LINK_RE (imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:505), so the package parses label-and-name-target links in three places that can drift; the addition does not reuse or share the existing reader.

follow-on: _sample recomputes the self-link predicate inline (candidate["link"].target == candidate["documenting_name"]) instead of calling the new find_self_links, and repeats the same rule at line 128 and line 198, so one change carries the rule in four places.

follow-on: 5 of the 180 rows carry an empty target_description (targets coolant_mass, parallel_normalized_perturbed_vector_potential, normalized_perturbed_vector_potential, atomic_count_of_pellet, power_at_outer_divertor_target), verified absent from the graph with a positive control that resolved 5130 StandardName nodes, so Jev judged those rows without the description the Noul names.

follow-on: the base gate log's own header names its command as uv run pytest -p no:cacheprovider with a placeholder instead of the file set, so a reader opening the log cannot see which files ran; the manifest's baseline_suite.command carries the literal command, so the record is recoverable.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base c3266f36fc06761122dbd99bf377fe8bce5ee493; 3418ad70b adds the detector and its test to doc_links.py and 92ee6e571 adds the 180-row sheet, the run script and the fragment, all five paths inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a test that flags a link to the documenting name and passes a neighbour (failing with the check removed), a Jev state carrying the target's description, and a sheet of at least 150 rows including every self-link with its probability; tests/standard_names/test_link_label_judgement.py holds the five tests and imas_codex/standard_names/doc_links.py:123 is the predicate the negative control reddens by removing the target==documenting check.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is deterministic self-link detection, Jev's per-link label judgement state, and the coordinator's labelling sheet; the diff adds imas_codex/standard_names/doc_links.py:107-183 (find_name_links, find_self_links, link_label_question, link_judgement_state) and lands the 180-row sheet ssog-link-label-sheet.json.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate command and result (142 passed, exit 0), the base arm at c3266f36f and head arm at 3418ad70b both at failure_count 0, the negative-control log (1 failed, EXIT=1), and the sheet metrics (180 rows, 74 self-links, 19 domains, spend USD 0.0037).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are imas_codex/standard_names/doc_links.py, tests/standard_names/test_link_label_judgement.py and the three ssog-link-label-sheet html, json and run.py files; the diff changes exactly those five files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_link_label_judgement.py:25 reddens when find_self_links drops its target==documenting_name filter, as negative_control.log records (1 failed, EXIT=1), and the other four assertions compare to literals rather than to the values under test.
justifications.evidence: the base gate log at revision c3266f36f (137 passed) and the head gate log (142 passed) are recorded complete with failure_count 0 in the manifest, and negative_control.log ends EXIT=1 on a real subcase.
justifications.fit: doc_links.py:107-183 follows the module's frozen-dataclass and tuple-returning idiom beside find_name_references, and adds no plan, version or author name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/doc_links.py:107-183 lands find_name_links, find_self_links and the Jev question and state the goal names, and ssog-link-label-sheet.json carries the 180 rows it asks for.
justifications.reuse: the additions extend the doc_links.py owner the design review designated, but doc_links.py:22 re-implements the label-and-target reader graph_ops already owns at graph_ops.py:9545 and graph_ops.py:505.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only c3266f36fc06761122dbd99bf377fe8bce5ee493 92ee6e571f1e0f77aa7d85e709e7cb41e0769617 names exactly the five declared write paths, with no file outside them.
